'''Japanese Premiere Starter Deck''' (printed 60カード スターターセット) is a 60-card [[Premiere (Japanese)]] product published by [[Takara]] in April 1997. MSRP was ¥1400. Each starter mixes Light and Dark Japanese Premiere cards plus a Japanese rulebook. Titles vary by pack. A display held 12 starters.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] (8 October 2026).</ref>
